Technical indicators suggest the market may remain volatile in the short term, with a 'wait-and-see' approach prevalent among market participants regarding the sustainability of recent rebounds.

providers.market_view: Technology stocks staged a strong rebound on Nov 11, driven by better-than-expected earnings from AI computing services company CoreWeave and strong demand for Anthropic's upcoming IPO. The semiconductor sector surged broadly, with all components of the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rising. The major indices posted solid gains, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq leading the way. The market flashed a follow-through day signal, suggesting a potential new uptrend. However, breadth was mediocre, with more stocks hitting new lows than new highs. Volatility fell sharply, indicating reduced fear. Fed funds futures reflected a high probability of a rate hike in December.
